neighbours.label: geological description of rock units and how they formed (marine sands, sedimentary beds, coarse-grained, volcano-plutonic), not the same words in biology, food, news or museums
fire: The formation comprises coarse-grained arkose interbedded with thin marine shales of Jurassic age.
Above the unconformity lie fluvial conglomerates derived from an uplifted granitic basement.
Drill cores recovered pillow basalts capped by deep-water chert and turbidites.
The sequence grades upward from shallow carbonate muds into cross-bedded aeolian sandstone.
These gneisses were intruded by mafic dykes during the Proterozoic collision.
Exposures along the coast show folded greywacke overlain by glacial till.
Ordovician limestones of the platform pass laterally into basinal graptolitic shales.
The volcanic arc supplied andesitic ash that accumulated in a forearc basin.
quiet: The aquarium keeps coarse-scaled fish in tanks of filtered marine water for visitors.
Above the fireplace hangs a painting of an old granite quarry at dusk.
Divers recovered gold coins and pottery from the deep water near the wreck.
The bakery sells coarse-grained rye and sandy shortbread from a stall by the sea.
These tourists were stopped by police during the protest at the volcano park.
Hikers along the coast take photos of the cliffs and eat lunch on the beach.
Students at the college pay for a field trip to the limestone caves each spring.
The volcanic ash cancelled flights and left many passengers sleeping at the airport.
